signal: Gorilla Logic, a nearshore software firm with 700+ engineers across Costa Rica, Colombia and Mexico, named to the Inc. 5000 five years running serving Fortune 500 clients

email.subject1: a signal play for Gorilla Logic
email.body1:
Jake, saw Gorilla Logic make the Inc. 5000 five years running, now 700-plus engineers across Costa Rica, Colombia and Mexico serving Fortune 500 clients.

Growth like that usually opens more enterprise accounts than the team can cover, and good-fit buyers go cold before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Gorilla Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jake, quick follow-up for Gorilla Logic.

Selling managed teams and staff augmentation into the enterprise is a relationship game, and reps end up buried in research and CRM work instead of selling. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Gorilla Logic needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jake, last bit of proof for Gorilla Logic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Gorilla Logic's reply rate likely compares to other B2B tech-services teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jake, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and running sales across a 700-engineer nearshore firm keeps a VP busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your services motion? I'll tailor it to Gorilla Logic either way.
